items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: And I saved Joe and Lulu. ... They had done run to Joe and cut Joe's fingers almost off.

ctx.x: Them white boys, the Lindenfield and Claiborne. They call them the twins. There was a bunch of brothers, they called the twins there. They was bad. Well, you saved him, huh? Yeah, I stopped them by me being around there, you see. I told them don't do anything. That was your gang? Yeah, that was all my gang, you see. And I saved Joe and Lulu. They had Lulu piled up in glass bottle. Twenty cases of bottles, empty bottles. They had her between the steps. They had done broke all them bottles, throwing at her. She was…

Yeah. Wait, no wait, let me see. After you have Lulu Pascal. I think she's living in Joe Pascal living. Wait a minute. Yeah, they carried him there. I don't know if she's living under that. I mean, I heard that name.
